title: Remove the retired "Host free with Crew" claim from the /what-is-frequency template and recapture its baselines

source.ref: LIVE-2267 follow-up: the /what-is-frequency template words are fingerprinted against committed visual baselines, so the copy change ships with a baseline recapture.

detail: The /what-is-frequency template still said Host free with Crew. It now says Hosting a Space is free, matching PLAN_STORY. Its words feed test/e2e/template-fingerprints.json, so the visual baselines are recaptured (e2e-manual update_baselines) and the fingerprints re-stamped in the same branch.
